title: Circle and a point on it
summary: A circle with a draggable point on the rim, its radius, and a tangent line.

steps.title: Center and rim
steps.detail: O is the center. P rides on the circle — every position of P is exactly distance r from O.

steps.title: Radius segment
steps.detail: The segment OP is a radius. Drag P and the length stays constant while the direction changes.

steps.title: Tangent at P
steps.detail: The red line touches the circle at P and is perpendicular to the radius OP.
